    {
      "sentence": "The child briefly lost consciousness while running and has perioral cyanosis, a single S2, and a left upper sternal border systolic ejection murmur.",
      "grounding": "question",
      "question_quote": "he was running with other kids in the park when he suddenly fell down and became unresponsive for less than 1 minute",
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "When he squats, his cyanosis improves and the murmur becomes louder.",
      "grounding": "question",
      "question_quote": "When the child squats, the murmur is intensified and the cyanosis improves.",
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "This pattern points to a hypercyanotic spell in tetralogy of Fallot, which characteristically produces a left upper sternal border ejection murmur, a single S2, and hypoxemia relieved by squatting.",
      "grounding": "passages",
      "question_quote": null,
      "passage_ids": ["First_Aid_Step2:000557"]
    },
    {
      "sentence": "Squatting raises systemic vascular resistance, reducing right-to-left shunting and directing more blood through the right ventricular outflow tract, which explains why the murmur gets louder as cyanosis improves.",
      "grounding": "none",
      "question_quote": null,
      "passage_ids": []
    },
    {
      "sentence": "The best immediate treatment among the options is morphine, oxygen, IV fluids, and a beta blocker such as propranolol.",
